summary: Comprehensive test suite with strong coverage of main requirements (cartesian product generation, exclude/include rules, validation, CLI, workflow integration). Good organization across unit tests, end-to-end pipeline tests, and workflow structure validation. Primary gaps: edge cases around type validation (failFast non-boolean not tested directly), multiple sequential include/exclude rules not tested together, string/number normalization functions used indirectly but not tested explicitly. The act-based pipeline testing is sophisticated, ensuring real GitHub Actions execution, but adds test complexity. Would catch most regressions in core functionality but might miss some corner cases.
